decisions.reason: As a design-led decorative fabric close to the core range, it is somewhat fashion-sensitive but still fits the firm's stocked and service-oriented interiors business well.

This transparent burnout decorative fabric looks like a more niche, style-driven line with overlap to other new decorative burnout products, making it the likeliest candidate for range rationalization.
A standard burnout decorative fabric remains close to the firm's established offer, so despite collection turnover risk it is still worth keeping unless sales clearly disappoint.
A velour-like upholstery fabric is strongly aligned with the firm's upholstery textile competence and should suit repeat B2B demand better than more fashion-led decorative items.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric adds a practical, serviceable product with clear application value and good fit to dependable supply and custom support.

The polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a useful adjacent product for made-to-measure and upholstery-related applications, though somewhat more exposed to price competition than the firm's main decorative fabrics.
